historicalContent.context: Per [[vaporize-is-the-substrate-canonical-tool-for-modification]] — all substrate structural moves (renames, relocations, installs, app deploys, schema changes) route through vaporize. The substrate-version-shift-down-one cascade includes PRODUCT-RELEASE directory renames at property component homes (release/v0.1.0/ → release/v0.0.1/) that schema-bump (sibling bead) does not cover because schema-bump is scoped to schema-family-version dirs, not property-product-release dirs. This bead names the vaporize extension needed.

newCapabilityNeeded: PRODUCT-RELEASE-DIR-RENAME mode: rename release/vX.Y.Z/ → release/v0.0.W/ at named property component home + update all substrate-wide path-deps in lockstep
(a) Swift source code: SiteRenderer + per-property renderers reference release/v0.1.0/ paths
(b) Cloudflare Pages deploy configs at property webroots: wrangler.toml + deploy-target.json + deploy-receipts
(d) Launch-review-packets + stack.route-bundles + workflow-instance records that cite release/vX.Y.Z/ paths
Per-property opt-in: vaporize prompts for OD-N per property (NOT mechanical assume) because some properties may have first-public-released as v0.1.0 (correct, NOT to be shifted)
Dry-run mode: report all path-deps that WOULD change before any writes
Atomic commit cascade: per-property + cross-submodule commits land in lockstep per [[shortcuts-cause-state-divergence-typed-record-state-must-stay-in-lockstep-with-world-state]]
candidatePropertiesIdentified: todo3 public/site/rismay-me/release/v0.1.0/ → release/v0.0.1/ (operator-attested rismay.me is shipping but per substrate-version doctrine v0.1.0 = FIRST PUBLIC RELEASE; need operator OD-N — is rismay.me at first-public-release or still substrate-pending?)

any other release/v0.1.0/ directories surfaced by full audit
designConsiderations: Mechanism — extend vaporize's existing rename + relocate capabilities with release-aware mode
Per-property RenameRequestModel input: typed record naming old path + new path + per-property rationale + operator OD-N attestation
Substrate-wide path-dep scanner BEFORE write: package-graph@wrkstrm.cli style reverse-cross-ref so all consumers updated in same commit cascade
Cloudflare Pages re-deploy: post-rename trigger automatic re-deploy with new path; emit deploy-receipt

produces: ProductReleaseRenameReceiptModel record at property component home
